style.vernacular: Dense historic core of stucco-rendered Baroque, Neoclassical and Art Nouveau townhouses in pastel ochre, cream, pink and grey with steep red clay-tile roofs and dormers; late-19th-century perimeter blocks with rich plaster ornament; 1960s-80s concrete panel (panelak) housing estates on the edge in grey, white and pastel-painted panels with flat membrane roofs; Baroque chateaux and village churches in white or yellow render with red tile; glass-and-render malls and offices at the periphery.
style.ornament: Baroque and Art Nouveau plaster ornament, sgraffito, pastel-painted facades with white window surrounds and cornices, mansard roofs with dormers, steep red clay-tile roofs, Secession decorative bands; on estates, prefabricated panel joints and coloured balcony panels.
